README: Outreach tracker — used by the n8n workflows. Do NOT rename tabs or header cells.
Flow: Contacts (find + verify email) → Messages (draft → QC → ready) → you tick "approved" → Sender → Replies/Log.
Messages.status: draft | needs_fix | ready | sending | sent | replied | bounced | held | cancelled | error
Contacts.email_status: (empty = to find) | to_verify | valid | risky | not_found     (invalid ones are cleared and retried automatically)
Contacts.contact_status: active | replied | refused | do_not_contact | bounced
To retry finding an email: put it in "email" (optional) and clear "email_status".
Editing a draft after approval clears the approval automatically and re-runs QC.
Second person at a company: only 1+ day after the first, and only if nobody there answered.
Config tab = all switches (DRY_RUN, TEST_RECIPIENT, DAILY_CAP, window...).
Config: TRUE = full run, nothing sent (rows get dry_run_at). FALSE = really send.
If filled and DRY_RUN=FALSE: every email goes to THIS address instead (rows get test_sent_at). Empty = LIVE.
Emergency stop. Set automatically on Gmail quota/credential errors.
Last send starts before this time.
Extra random 0..N s delay before each send.
Second person at same company only after N days and only if nobody there answered.
Auto-draft follow-ups (they still need QC + your approval).
Calendar days without reply before a follow-up is drafted.
Telegram message for every send / dry-run.
Keep = Gmail so replies land in the thread and are detected.
